gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-faustina: Expressive from the first stroke, Funnel Display draws every line like spaghetti, while Faustina thins its bowls gently and keeps its capitals only slightly taller. The sharpest gap is the stroke itself.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-halant: Tube-bright and bold, Funnel Display draws its strokes like neon with no thick-thin shift at all. And Halant, a text serif with a faint pen-like swing and a towering x-height, gives each line somewhere sturdier to land.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-headland-one: Commanding in its constant, neon-tube lines, Funnel Display leads a body of Headland One, whose heavier verticals recall a gently tilted nib. One is built for impact; the other for dignity.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hedvig-letters-: Hedvig Letters Serif reads sturdy and tall in the body, with open-ended curves and a gentle ebb and flow of weight beneath Funnel Display's uniform lines. Give the body a little extra size.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC brings gentle modulation and terminals pulled well back, a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals. Marcellus SC keeps a long passage dignified and literary, while Funnel Display's marker-like line stays bold above it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-montagu-slab: Funnel Display draws a lack of stress in every curve, a loud, uniform line made to command attention, and Montagu Slab answers differently. But the text serif's heavier verticals and slender turns are what carry the reading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-hent: Outline-like and unshaded up top, then a refined surprise below. Noto Serif Hentaigana, a classic serif with open jaws and light contrast, would read smoothly over a long passage beneath Funnel Display's single-weight heading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-ovo: Authoritative and classic in feel, this pairing sets Funnel Display's ballpoint-pen line against a quieter texture. Ovo, a text serif with thins only slightly lighter than thicks, is where the pair's strongest quality lives: shaded warmth under a flat heading.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-literata: Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, its tube-like strokes glowing like neon glass with terminals cut open. Literata, a serif with moderate thick and thin strokes, is the strongest quality of the pair: a bookish, sturdy counterweight.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-sentient: Sentient is pinched and closed-in, with slightly lighter joins. Beside Gabarito's open, outward-flowing letters it feels like a tight, composed answer to a wide-open call, two moods that make each other noticeable.
